subject: Formal offer — financial breakdown and sign-off for Samira Khan
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Draft offer for Samira Khan — comp breakdown attached

Hi Monica / Karthik,

Please find attached a proposed package for Samira Khan (Senior ML Engineer, IC4). Samira is currently at Orbit Analytics and has a strong ML infra background — we want to move fast. The attached comp_breakdown has line items for base, target bonus, and RSU grant using our standard L4/L5 mix. I sketched two variants:

- Option A (competitive): base $170,000, 15% target bonus, 0.7% RSU (4y, quarterly vest)
- Option B (budget-conscious): base $165,000, 10% target bonus, 0.5% RSU

Other notes: 90-day performance review, standard relocation stipend if needed, standard equity cliff/vesting schedule.

Can you confirm which option fits the current band for IC4 at L5 equivalency and whether we need exec sign-off on the RSU size? Also copying Laura for People Ops visibility on start-date flexibility.

Attachments: comp_breakdown_20270803.xlsx

Thanks,
Connor
Connor O'Brien
Director, Machine Learning Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft offer for Samira Khan — comp breakdown attached

Connor,

Thanks for the packet — looks clean. A few quick clarifying Qs before we push to offer:

1) Which band are you mapping Samira to? If you consider this L5-equivalent, the 0.7% RSU is slightly above our typical midpoint. We can approve up to 0.6% without Director+ sign-off.

2) Is the relocation stipend expected? If yes, please confirm amount (we normally do up to $10k for domestic).

3) Preferred start date window? We should aim to have all offer docs ready 48–72 hours after candidate verbal acceptance.

If you can confirm, I’ll update the offer letter and route via DocuSign. I’m attaching an org chart snippet to show manager chain for the letter.

Attachments: org_chart_engineering.png

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Compensation Analyst, People Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft offer for Samira Khan — comp breakdown attached

Connor / Monica,

Thanks for flagging. I reviewed Option A/B. My recommendation: we extend Option A but reduce RSU to 0.6% (still attractive and within Director approval). Approve base $170k, 15% target bonus, RSU 0.6% (4y quarterly).

Relocation: approve up to $10k; candidate can request a higher amount but that would need exec exception.

Proceed to finalize the offer letter. Please include the 90-day performance check and standard signing bonus language (if you plan to include one, note amount).

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: TalentBridge Recruiting <recruiter@talentbridge.co>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@example.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood Inference — Formal Offer for Samira Khan

Samira / TalentBridge team,

Great speaking with you both. Per our conversations, please find attached the formal offer for Samira — approved by People Ops and the hiring org. Highlights:

- Base salary: $170,000/year
- Target bonus: 15% (annual, pro-rated first year)
- RSU grant: 0.6% of company (4-year vest, 1-year cliff, quarterly thereafter)
- Relocation: up to $10,000 reimbursement
- Expected start window: between Oct 4 and Oct 18, 2027 (flexible; confirm preference)

Please sign the offer via this DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/REDW-Offer-2027-08-05 (expires in 7 days). I’ve included standard retirement, benefits, and termination language in the attached PDF.

If you need any edits to the start date or wording around relocation timing, reply here and we’ll adjust.

Attachments: redwood_offer_samira_khan_20270805.pdf

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Director, Machine Learning Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@example.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: TalentBridge Recruiting <recruiter@talentbridge.co>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — Formal Offer for Samira Khan

Hi Connor — thanks so much for the offer and for moving quickly. I really appreciate the clarity. A couple quick questions before I sign:

1) Can the start date be pushed to Oct 25 instead of the Oct 4–18 window? I have a project ramp at my current role that needs a little extra handoff time.
2) On relocation: would the $10k be paid upfront or reimbursed after receipts? My preference is upfront to cover upfront moving expenses.

If those two items are ok, I’m prepared to sign immediately.

Best,
Samira Khan
Senior ML Engineer
On Fri, 6 Aug 2027 14:15:00 -0700 Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Samira — appreciate the quick response. We can push the start date to Oct 25; Monica, can we note that as an approved start date?
>
> Regarding relocation, the standard approach is reimbursement against receipts; Monica, is there flexibility to advance a portion?
>
> —Connor
